raw_wire_boundaries.positive: same parameter instance across direct/local/branch/loop/internal singleton slot and nested keep; ordinary private slot A can be discharged while fresh B/C enters keep; a closure body can use and discharge its own private slot without keep
negative: direct and singleton-slot old borrowed address used after move
symbolic F into MakePackage or StorePackageField followed by Return of the old SSA

raw_wire_boundaries.raw_declaration_scope: The public role kind is checked as the raw candidate's declaration; original source fidelity is checked by frontend source-to-Types tests.

budget.old_fresh_difference: two Fresh source fields at +2 logical units each; no private-slot scan on old profile

wire31.mutation: TakeLocal(other) -> TakeLocal(e) at the actual callback argument, leaving the later view use unchanged; retain analyzed plan and update typed fingerprint

returned_capture_probe.mutation: swap parent TakeCapture before old CallClosureBorrowed, preserve candidate plan, update module fingerprint
returned_capture_probe.positive: raw/Wire accepted with or without consumer edge
returned_capture_probe.negative: raw/Wire E-BORROW-CONFLICT with or without consumer edge

private_slot_profile.boundary: closed owning Array<Closure;1> admitted only as a function-private local/SSA carrier with a finite operation whitelist; public parameters/results/captures/State/Store remain under their older gates
private_slot_profile.control: R1 A is dropped, unrelated same-type B enters keep; R2 correlated branches each drop A then keep B/C; raw and Wire both accept because responsibilities and loans are independently valid
private_slot_profile.no_keep_closure_body: self-contained closure entry with its own private Array1 local constructs, takes, drops and returns scalar; raw and Wire pass
private_slot_profile.negative: owning callback Array1 SSA constructed with no actual local carrier rejects raw and Wire
private_slot_profile.proof: resources::check_module and borrows::check_module independently reconstruct actual CFG responsibility, element liveness and old loan invalidation; retained::provenance remains mandatory for Parameter-return F
private_slot_profile.prepayment: only functions marked by the existing locals/SSA type check scan private carriers; per-instruction operand size-hint and UnpackVariant field bound are charged before traversal

operand_probe.byvalue_fn_then_return: raw/Wire E-VERIFY-CALLABLE-CONTRACT because symbolic F has no Copy grant
operand_probe.legal_i32_control: shared Fn local call with actual i32 argument, then TakeLocal F and return; raw/Wire pass
operand_probe.shared_bad_f_as_i32: same Shared call with argument changed to Load(F), raw/Wire E-VERIFY-CLOSURE-CALL
